song.lyrics:
[V1] One day You'll make everything new, Jesus One day You will bind every wound The former things shall all pass away No more tears
[V2] One day You'll make sense of it all, Jesus One day every question resolved Every anxious thought left behind No more fear
[C1] When we all get to heaven What a day of rejoicing that will be When we all see Jesus We'll sing and shout the victory
[V3] One day we will see face to face, Jesus Is there a greater vision of grace And in a moment, we shall be changed On that day
[V4] And one day we'll be free, free indeed, Jesus One day all this struggle will cease And we will see Your glory revealed On that day
song.title: One day
song.aka: When we all get to heaven
